problem_type: Shared test temp roots hand out a symlinked path, so path comparisons against resolved paths fail only on macOS
symptom: On macOS, pnpm run gates is red on a clean origin/main: check:main-guard ('门岗推荐的写法必须在本平台真的触发 main()'), check:git-path-quoting ('退回默认 quotePath 的 hook 必须被门岗拦下') and check:claude-hooks (pre-push-check.node-test.mjs, including the control case '没改任何东西时同一个门岗是绿的'). Linux CI is green, so nobody saw it.
direct_cause: f75249952 (2026-10-08) moved every node:test temp dir onto scripts/_test-temp.mjs makeTempDir and in the process dropped four local fs.realpathSync calls. makeTempDir returns path.join(os.tmpdir(), …) unresolved; on macOS os.tmpdir() is /var/folders/… which is a symlink to /private/var/folders/…. Child processes' import.meta.url, git rev-parse --show-toplevel and process.cwd() report the resolved /private/var path, so 'am I the main module' checks never fire and repo-root comparisons never match.
class_root: The shared temp-root boundaries (scripts/_test-temp.mjs for node:test, tests/setup/tempWorkspace.ts for Vitest) did not guarantee a canonical (symlink-resolved) path, leaving each caller to remember realpath. CI only runs on Linux, where tmpdir is not a symlink, so a forgotten realpath can never go red in CI.

invariant_owner_layer.why: makeTempDir/makeTempDirAsync are the only node:test system-temp allocators (check:test-temp-static forbids others) and createTempWorkspace owns the Vitest run TMPDIR; both now resolve symlinks, and both are tested with a symlinked TMPDIR on Linux CI.

affected_population: Every developer or agent running pnpm run gates / pnpm run test on macOS (os.tmpdir() is a /var → /private/var symlink)
Any machine whose TMPDIR points through a symlink
394 node:test files that use makeTempDir/makeTempDirAsync and every Vitest test that calls os.tmpdir() under the run workspace
entry_points: node:test temp roots: makeTempDir / makeTempDirAsync in scripts/_test-temp.mjs
Vitest run workspace: createTempWorkspace in tests/setup/tempWorkspace.ts, which sets TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP for the whole run

external_sources.purpose: fs.realpathSync resolves symlinks to the canonical path that import.meta.url and child cwd report
os.tmpdir() reads TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP and returns it unresolved, which lets a Linux test reproduce the macOS symlinked tmpdir

invariants: Every temp root handed out by a shared test helper is equal to fs.realpathSync of itself
The canonical-root rule is exercised on Linux CI with a symlinked TMPDIR, so it cannot regress silently

door_reduction.why_not: door-map.mjs only scans src/electron, so these were enumerated by grep over scripts/ and tests/. makeTempDir and makeTempDirAsync are the sync/async halves of one helper used by 394 node:test files; createTempWorkspace is the Vitest-wide TMPDIR owner that the ~40 local electron/**/*.test.ts makeTempDir helpers inherit through os.tmpdir(). node:test and Vitest are separate runners with separate setup, so one boundary per runner is the minimum; all three now canonicalize.

generality_proof: Callers no longer need to remember realpath: every node:test temp root comes from makeTempDir/makeTempDirAsync (check:test-temp-static already forbids hand-rolled mkdtemp under os.tmpdir()), and every Vitest os.tmpdir() call resolves under the canonical TMPDIR set by createTempWorkspace. The four dropped realpath calls (main-guard, git-path-quoting x2, pre-push-check) are all covered by the helper, not re-added locally.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Return a symlink-resolved temp root for every node:test caller (sync and async).
Create the Vitest run root at its resolved path and point TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP at it, so every os.tmpdir() under Vitest is canonical.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: 放行的写法在当前平台真的会执行
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Lost fs.realpathSync in f75249952; red on macOS before this fix, green after (pnpm run check:main-guard exit 0).

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: 真仓库当下是干净的；任意一处退回默认写法 → 门岗必须报红
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Lost realpath of the nomi-quotepath-gate fixture in f75249952; its own comment says the CLI branch never runs without realpath. Green after the fix.
Lost realpath of the nomi-gitpaths- fixture in f75249952; now canonical through makeTempDir.
Lost fs.realpathSync(os.tmpdir()) in f75249952; check:claude-hooks red on macOS including the control case, green after the fix.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: local makeTempDir (one of ~40 electron test helpers)
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Local helpers call fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), …)); under Vitest os.tmpdir() is the TMPDIR set by createTempWorkspace, which is now canonical.

recurrence.reason: Any new test that compares a temp path with import.meta.url, git output or a child cwd would hit the same mismatch on macOS, and Linux CI could not catch it. The failure already recurred once (realpath added in 757b31508, silently lost in f75249952).
same_class_scan: git show f75249952 | grep '^-.*realpath' → exactly 4 removed realpath calls, mapping to the 3 red gates
grep -rlE 'makeTempDir(Async)?\(' scripts tests → 394 node:test consumers of the shared helper
grep -rn 'function makeTempDir' electron → ~40 local Vitest helpers, all deriving from os.tmpdir() under createTempWorkspace
grep -n mkdtemp tests/setup/tempWorkspace.ts → the Vitest run root was also unresolved

prevention.invariant: makeTempDir/makeTempDirAsync/createTempWorkspace return fs.realpathSync of the created directory.
prevention.failure_mode: If the helpers stop resolving, the class tests run on Linux CI with TMPDIR pointed at a symlink and fail (check:test-temp-static and the Unit job).
prevention.strategy: Resolve at the two shared temp boundaries so no caller can get a symlinked root, and reproduce the macOS symlinked tmpdir on Linux so CI enforces it.

legacy_paths.rationale: No parallel path exists; the per-test realpath calls were already removed in f75249952 and are not re-added.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The behaviour comes from the OS temp-directory symlink and Node's documented os.tmpdir(); no third-party dependency is involved.

migration: None needed: temp roots are created per run and deleted afterwards; no stored state references them.
residual_risks: check:design-lab is still red on macOS for a different reason (97 stale pixel baselines because the visual gate only runs on darwin and is skipped on Linux CI); it is tracked separately and needs a decision on where baselines are recorded.
Tests that build temp paths from os.tmpdir() outside Vitest and outside makeTempDir (for example tests/ux walkthrough scripts) are not covered by this boundary.
